$comment: Channelization grid for the tuning step/snap model. Frequency-range keyed (NOT keyed to the vendored bandplan-usa.json names, which are too inconsistent to match on). `from`/`to` are inclusive Hz bounds; `step` is the Auto tuning increment; `snap` true means Auto also rounds the VFO to this grid; `grid_offset_hz` (optional, default 0) phases the grid so e.g. US FM lands on 87.9/88.1/... rather than 88.0/88.2. `mode` is a hint chip. US/region-2 values for now; a region selector + non-US tables come later. First matching range wins (ordered low->high, non-overlapping). Bands with no rule fall back to the default step and never snap.

ranges.$note: MW AM broadcast, Americas 10 kHz channels (ITU-R1/R3 use 9 kHz - region selector TBD).
HF broadcast 5 kHz raster. Ham SSB/CW segments fall in here too but the active SSB/CW demod forces snap off, so this stays safe.
US FM 200 kHz spacing on the odd-tenth grid (87.9, 88.1, ...).
VHF airband AM, 25 kHz (8.33 kHz spacing not modelled yet).
2 m. FM repeater grid; the SSB/CW sub-band is handled by the demod-forces-continuous override.
